column1: # The OpenBLAS kernel each BLAS-dependent fixture without its own run record was made under
# (docs/PLAN.md A5b; milestone M11). Tests that compare a BLAS-dependent result with a fixture
# first check that the kernel in use is this one (rcompat::blas::require_fixture_kernel). Fixtures
# that hold their R run's summary.json (tests/fixtures/doubletfinder/<object>/reference/) are read
# from it instead. The kernel is the one the fixture's R run recorded: in its fingerprint
# (run.fingerprint.openblas_corename of the run named), or in validation/manifest.toml's profile.
